review.posthog_relevance: Adds a utility function `asItemArray` to safely distinguish between null, non-array, and array values, replacing unsafe array casts in workflow activity description rendering. This supports workflow activity log display and testing.

observations.behavior: Replaces unsafe array casts with asItemArray and adds a guard to treat non-array values as a generic update rather than attempting array-specific diffs.
